FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions

booking.question: How do I book an apartment?
booking.answer: Choose the apartment you like, set your check-in and check-out dates and number of guests, and press the booking button. The owner will confirm your request within 24 hours.

payment.question: How does payment work?
payment.answer: Payment is made via the platform balance. Top up your balance with a bank card (TBC, BOG) and pay the booking amount.

verifiedOwner.question: What is a verified owner?
verifiedOwner.answer: A verified owner is someone who has successfully passed identity verification, property documentation checks and admin approval.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel a booking?
cancellation.answer: Yes, bookings can be cancelled. The cancellation policy depends on the rules set by the owner. Generally, cancelling at least 48 hours in advance gets a full refund.

becomeOwner.question: How do I become an owner on the platform?
becomeOwner.answer: Register, add your property with photos and a description, upload your proof of ownership document, and wait for admin approval.

services.question: What services are available on the platform?
services.answer: The platform offers: transport and transfers, services and craftsmen, entertainment and activities, food and restaurants, job listings, and more.

smartMatch.question: What is Smart Match?
smartMatch.answer: Smart Match is our algorithm that automatically picks the best apartments for you based on your preferences: budget, location, number of guests and other criteria.

support.question: How do I contact the support team?
support.answer: You can reach the support team via the platform chat, email or phone. Our team is available daily from 09:00 to 21:00.
